purpose: Production state layout and cross-owner references. Synthetic repeat/truncate payloads are forbidden.

source_cache.last_phase: U8 enum UNSET=0, NORMAL=1, CACHED_DRAIN=2; cold exact value UNSET/0

event_control.owned_state: exact nested F01E_SELECTED_COLD_V1 / warm successor using parameters/f01e-selected-constructor-v1.json schema: objects[28], optional control snapshots, optional DBMD binding, cold-null then runtime graph-derived physical binding, immutable config
event_control.derived_control38: callback-local U32[38][13] per provider graph adapter; not persistent independent state
event_control.derived_regular37: callback-local rows control38[sorted hosts excluding semantic lfe_host]; not a 37x13 sampler state

render_audio.diffusion_instances: optional[37] exact F04F state encoded by specs/04-diffusion-filter-and-lifecycle.md section 6
render_audio.diffusion_previous_outputs: optional F32[37][4][1536] with presence bound to the same active instance

source_flags.current_flags: U8[48][2]; histories alias no storage and read render_audio.regular_raw_history before its single commit

profile_dimensions.active_target_count_n: runtime integer 0..15; arrays allocate T=15 and consume prefix [0:n]

selection_outer.target_current_xyz: F32[T=15][3]; cold exact U32 words from parameters/f03-selected-target-cold-v1.json
selection_outer.f03g_gate_output: callback-local candidate_ids U32[N=48] plus candidate_count 0..48; no persistent state
selection_outer.f03a_selector: callback-local affinity F32[N=48][N=48], complement U8[48][48], feature F32[B=24][48], response F32[T=15][48], support F32[48], Q F32[15], total/weight F32[24], mask U8[15], coverage F32[15], selected U32[T=15] plus selected_count 0..15; cold scratch all positive zero/empty
selection_outer.f03u_refinement: callback-local source_weight F32[N=48], membership_gain F32[N=48][T=15], projection_matrix F32[T=15][N=48], projected_xyz F32[T=15][3]; consume candidate/selected prefixes; cold scratch positive zero; allocate only for CAPACITY_REACHED
selection_outer.f03n_nnls: callback-local context F32[T=15][T=15], response F32[T=15], seed/solution F32[T=15], passive/active index U32[T=15], active count n in 0..15 and loops use [0:n]; cold scratch positive zero/index zero
selection_outer.f03s_outer: per source callback-local H/L F32[T=15][T=15], rhs/solution/correction F32[T=15], index_state U32[T=15] cold zero and scalar_flag U32=0; active n in 0..15 and loops use [0:n]; no persistent state

matrix_assignment.writer_set: ordered unique destination records; no metadata history stored here

cold_constructors.source_cache: both optional caches absent; last_phase U8=0 UNSET
cold_constructors.render_audio: all numeric histories positive zero and no diffusion instances
cold_constructors.source_flags: flags are callback output, no independent history
cold_constructors.selection_outer: parameters/f03-selected-target-cold-v1.json plus all declared scratch positive-zero/empty/index-zero constructors
cold_constructors.matrix_assignment: assignment=-1, markers=0, matrix positive zero, writer_set empty

serialization: Canonical map in shown field order; fixed arrays row-major; integers little-endian; F32 exact U32 bits; optional values carry presence byte; variable records carry U32LE count and length. Callback-local scratch is never serialized. No pointers, padding, hash-expanded bytes or zero-filled unknown state.
commit: F03W commits only f03w_owned_fields once after its leaf stages and downstream receipts all pass. External state is committed by its unique owner under the enclosing source transaction.
failure: All owner roots retain complete before bytes and generation; top-level result is RETIRED with commit_count=0.
reset: Destroy every owner root and call each referenced cold constructor. Missing cold constructor is fatal; unknown arrays may not be zero-filled.
fixture_note: AI48ST01 repeated-digest payloads belong only to historical r2 composition fixture and are not production state.
